summary: Checks whether one grid range is **not** entirely within another.
description: The negation of `isGridRangeContainedIn`, written so that a guard clause reads as a sentence: a range that overlaps only partly, or lies elsewhere entirely, both answer `true`.

params.range2: The range it is compared against.

returns: `true` when the first range is not inside the second.

examples.title: Checking containment
